# Bobsome1.com

Bobsome1.com is the public home of Project Unveiled by Robert J. Hayes.

## Primary resources
- Homepage: https://bobsome1.com/
- Project Unveiled overview: https://bobsome1.com/book/
- Complete reader directory: https://bobsome1.com/book/read/
- Begin Chapter One: https://bobsome1.com/book/read/chapter-01.html
- Interactive historical timeline: https://bobsome1.com/book/timeline.html
- Research standards and corrections: https://bobsome1.com/book/research.html
- Reader reviews and scholarly review desk: https://bobsome1.com/book/reviews.html
- Public project updates: https://bobsome1.com/book/updates.html
- Works consulted: https://bobsome1.com/book/read/appendix-e.html
- Support Right Hand Ministry: https://bobsome1.com/book/read/support-right-hand.html
- Privacy: https://bobsome1.com/privacy.html

## Trust-Worthy evidence
- Public cases and editorial context: https://bobsome1.com/truth/
- OpenAPI for searching published claims and retrieving case records: https://bobsome1.com/truth/api/openapi.json
- Public case catalog: https://bobsome1.com/truth/api/claims.php

These are published, provisional case assessments. Cite the public case URL, ID, and version. A missing match only means the published catalog did not return a record.

## Content notes
Project Unveiled is a complete public edition with 13 chapters and supporting appendices. It distinguishes documented history, interpretation, theological argument, and open questions. Corrections and stronger evidence are welcomed.

Reader reactions, expert reviews, historical corrections, and source evidence are treated as different categories. The review desk does not publish manufactured endorsements, fake ratings, or anonymous quotes presented as expert review.
